reason: Complete the original v2 task-conditioned fiber/relevance question and its planned adversarial latent-pair search. Existing positive-lambda fixed-theta measurements vary the task coordinate. Do not relabel or replace those measurements.
timing: Recorded before new saved-model fixed-u metrics and adversarial outcomes. Original fixed-theta metrics, noise completion and seed-zero/replication certificates were already observed. This is a post-hoc semantic completion, not an original preregistration or an independent confirmatory discovery.
cohort: All 210 relevance-view models in the unchanged production-noise source plan: six lambdas, seven gammas, five paired seeds. The lambda-zero 35 models are original primary members. No new training or model selection.
selection: First stored checkpoint at or below training loss 0.1; last current hidden layer, exact original config/checkpoint/embedding bindings. Retain unreached-risk status without a final-checkpoint substitution.
task_coordinate: u = theta + lambda*sin(phi) mod 2*pi. Fixed-u circle: theta = u - lambda*sin(phi). Fixed-theta control: theta = base. Neither is the complete four-class target-label fiber.
grid: Base coordinate and phi both use (i+0.5)*2*pi/100, i=0..99. Every family has 100 circles by 100 points. Lambda-zero families coincide and their results are reused exactly. This is a new half-offset grid, not a replacement of the old original grid.
derivative: Analytic float64 chain rule through saved ReLUs. Fixed-u derivative is J_phi-lambda*cos(phi)*J_theta; control is J_phi. Report raw per-phi norms, unit flat-torus-tangent norms using sqrt(1+lambda^2*cos(phi)^2), and unit actual embedded-input tangent norms. ReLU derivative at exactly zero uses the implementation convention zero and is counted; no continuum smoothness claim.
scale: For each family, centered representation RMS over its declared grid. Preserve raw norms and margins and divide by the same family RMS only when positive. Different grid scales and achieved checkpoint losses remain reported.
dense_pairs: All 4950 distinct pairs per circle, 495000 total per family. Report representation distance divided by wrapped phi arc and separately by flat-T2 ambient geodesic distance of original theta/phi pairs. Minimum and quantiles are sampled evidence only.
collisions: Report exact floating equality and distance-at-or-below fixed absolute tolerance separately. Neither finite-grid equality nor absence of a sampled collision is a real-valued continuum certificate.

adversarial_search.initialization: Independent uniform base, first phi in [0,2*pi); uniform initial arc in [pi/8,pi], mapped to an unconstrained logit. Same starts paired across all models/families.
adversarial_search.parameterization: Optimize base b, first angle a, v with delta=pi/8+(pi-pi/8)*sigmoid(v), second phi=a+delta. Embed both points on the declared same-base fiber; no label or task-preservation penalty substitutes for the exact parameterization.
adversarial_search.objective: Mean across 16 independent starts of ||h(x1)-h(x2)||/(delta*family_RMS). Retain the smallest evaluated candidate among all 16 starts at initialization and after each of 64 updates. Preserve its base, phi pair, latent pair, task-coordinate equality error, raw distance, phi-arc ratio, ambient-geodesic ratio and normalized ratios. A found minimum is an upper bound on the infimum and is not a collision certificate.
adversarial_search.zero_scale: Retain constant-grid status and skip division-based optimization; do not silently manufacture a finite normalized margin.

classifier: Evaluate both full centered branches and heads on each declared grid and report actual four-class accuracy using the original periodic task. Fixed-u labels are constant within each circle and this is checked. Accuracy is finite-grid evidence, not the continuous decision certificates from lambda zero.
replay: Repeat every model's metrics/search in a separate invocation on the same host and fixed two-thread float64 runtime. Structural/source fields exact; numerical relative tolerance 1e-10 and absolute 1e-12. This is same-implementation numerical reproducibility, not an independent verifier.
statistics: All six relevance levels and seven gammas reported, with five paired training seeds. Pointwise 95% percentile seed bootstrap, 2000 repeats. Pair task-preserving minus fixed-theta within model and positive-lambda minus zero at fixed gamma. Do not treat grid points, pair candidates or optimization starts as independent training replicates. No new effect-selected hypothesis thresholds or p-values.
scope: Finite evidence for retention along exact task-coordinate-preserving circles versus original-factor controls in saved ordinary MLPs. No all-theta or full-torus injectivity, causal OOD effect, full target-law quotient, information destruction, new general verifier/theorem, or guaranteed high novelty. The original negative predictive comparison remains unchanged.
